name: Hex: Under Your Thumb

description.content: The first time a Survivor gains a Hook State, a Dull Totem ignites.
Whenever a running Survivor gains [Haste] within [32m] of you, you are alerted.
Running Survivors cannot gain more than [15%] [Haste] at a time.

quote: "They will run, but Judgment will make the very ground they tread turn to ash and smoke." (Visions of Gerhardt, ch. 1)
